title: SwiftData Relationships & Cascade Delete
hints: Declare the to-many side with `@Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Book.author)`.
Insert the book, then append it to the author's `books` — the inverse is set for you.
jsBridge: `@Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse:)` declares related models. SwiftData infers many inverses, and cascade deletes follow the graph, like ORM relations with `onDelete: cascade`.

compass.q: Prisma requires both sides of a relation in the schema. What does SwiftData infer for you?
